question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH jan_jun_orders AS (
    SELECT USER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS order_count
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.SOURCES.ORDERS
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01'
    GROUP BY USER_ID
),
jul_dec_orders AS (
    SELECT USER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS order_count
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.SOURCES.ORDERS
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jan_jun_orders WHERE order_count > 1) AS repeat_customers_jan_jun,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jul_dec_orders WHERE order_count > 1) AS repeat_customers_jul_dec;

action.answer: In January–June 2025, there were 95,048 repeat customers (users who placed more than one order in that period). In July–December 2025, there were 96,514 repeat customers (users who placed more than one order in that period). Evaluating repeat status separately for each half, July–December 2025 had more repeat customers than January–June 2025.
action.reason: Counts were calculated by identifying users with more than one order in each half-year period. The second half of 2025 had 1,466 more repeat customers than the first half.
